craft.name: James Webb Space Telescope
craft.desc: Infrared observatory orbiting the Sun-Earth L2 point, 1.5 million km behind Earth.

craft.name: Voyager 1
craft.desc: The most distant human-made object, travelling through interstellar space since 2012.

craft.name: Voyager 2
craft.desc: The only spacecraft to visit Uranus and Neptune; in interstellar space since 2018.

craft.name: Parker Solar Probe
craft.desc: Flies through the Sun’s corona, the fastest human-made object, to study the solar wind.

craft.name: New Horizons
craft.desc: Flew past Pluto in 2015 and Arrokoth in 2019; now exploring the outer Kuiper Belt.

craft.name: Juno
craft.desc: Polar orbiter studying Jupiter’s interior, magnetic field and auroras.

craft.name: Europa Clipper
craft.desc: Cruising to Jupiter to make dozens of flybys of the ice-covered ocean moon Europa.

craft.name: Psyche
craft.desc: Heading for the metal-rich asteroid 16 Psyche in the main belt.

craft.name: Lucy
craft.desc: First mission to the Trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit.

craft.name: BepiColombo
craft.desc: Two orbiters on their way to Mercury, using repeated planetary flybys to slow down.

craft.name: Solar Orbiter
craft.desc: Takes the first images of the Sun’s poles, orbiting inside the orbit of Mercury.

craft.name: JUICE
craft.desc: Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer: en route to study Ganymede, Callisto and Europa.
